properties.title: Ocean-view townhome three blocks from the bluff
properties.description_en:
A front-facing townhome on a quiet terrace three blocks from the bluff, with ocean views from the living floor and the roof deck.

Three bedrooms, an elevator to all levels, and a two-car garage — the combination that keeps this pocket of Santa Monica liquid even in slower quarters. Recently repriced to meet the market.

HOA covers exterior, roof and common insurance.
properties.description_es: Una casa adosada frontal en una terraza tranquila a tres cuadras del acantilado, con vistas al mar desde la planta principal y la azotea.

agent.bio_en: David leads the coastal practice, from Carbon Beach to the Palisades bluffs. A former land-use analyst, he is the person clients call when a property's value turns on a coastal permit, a setback or a view easement.

properties.title: A restored 1948 post-and-beam with a new kitchen
properties.description_en:
A 1948 post-and-beam that has been brought forward carefully: the original structure, clerestory glazing and brick hearth are intact, while the kitchen, baths, systems and roof are all new within the last two years.

The plan is a genuine four-bedroom, with a north-facing garden that stays usable through August and a detached studio at the rear currently used as an office.

Open house Saturday and Sunday, 1–4pm.
properties.description_es: Una casa post-and-beam de 1948 restaurada con cuidado: la estructura original, los ventanales altos y la chimenea de ladrillo intactos; cocina, baños e instalaciones nuevos.

properties.title: Sand-level contemporary on a rare wide frontage
properties.description_en:
Fifty-eight feet of frontage on one of the wider sand parcels at Point Dume, with a permitted seawall already in place — the detail that decides value on this stretch.

The house is planned in three levels that step back from the water: a glass-walled living floor at sand level, bedrooms above, and a roof deck that clears the neighbouring rooflines. A detached studio at the motor court serves as a guest suite or office.

Coming to market shortly. Private previews are available to qualified buyers.
properties.description_es: Casi dieciocho metros de frente en una de las parcelas más anchas de Point Dume, con malecón ya permitido — el detalle que decide el valor en este tramo de costa.

properties.title: A canyon-edge modern above the Sunset Strip

images.caption: Living room with retractable glass wall

properties.description_en:
Set on a promontory at the top of the Bird Streets, this 2019 residence is organised around a single uninterrupted view corridor that runs from the canyon wall to the Pacific.

The main level opens completely: forty feet of glass retract into the walls so the living room, the terrace and the pool deck read as one room. Below, four bedroom suites share a gallery-lit hall; above, the primary occupies its own floor with a private terrace, dual dressing rooms and a stone bath that faces due west.

Offered with a full 360° tour of the principal rooms.
properties.description_es:
Situada en un promontorio en lo alto de las Bird Streets, esta residencia de 2019 se organiza en torno a un único corredor de vistas que va desde la pared del cañón hasta el Pacífico.

El nivel principal se abre por completo: doce metros de cristal se retraen en los muros.

properties.title: Gated family estate on just under an acre
properties.description_en:
Just under an acre behind a guarded gate, with the flat usable yard that is genuinely scarce in the Santa Monica Mountains foothills.

Five bedrooms including a main-floor suite, a pool and spa, a sport court, and an outdoor kitchen under a covered loggia. The house was built in 2004 and re-roofed and re-piped in 2021.

Currently in escrow; back-up offers are being accepted.
properties.description_es: Poco menos de media hectárea tras una puerta con vigilancia, con el patio plano y utilizable que escasea en las estribaciones de las Santa Monica Mountains.
highlights: Five bedrooms including a main-floor suite

communities.name: Beverly Hills
communities.tagline_en: Flat streets, deep lots, and the most durable address in California.
communities.tagline_es: Calles llanas, lotes profundos y la dirección más duradera de California.
communities.description_en:
The flats south of Sunset trade on lot width and street canopy; north of Sunset the market is driven by architecture and privacy. Inventory is thin in both, and the gap between a renovated house and a project has widened every quarter for two years.

Buyers here are usually trading up from the Westside or relocating from out of state, and they underwrite on land value first, improvements second.
communities.description_es: Los terrenos al sur de Sunset se valoran por el ancho del lote; al norte de Sunset el mercado lo impulsan la arquitectura y la privacidad. El inventario es escaso en ambos.

communities.name: Malibu
communities.tagline_en: Twenty-one miles of coastline, and no two blocks priced alike.
communities.tagline_es: Treinta y cuatro kilómetros de costa, y ni dos manzanas con el mismo precio.
communities.description_en:
Malibu is not one market but a dozen: beachfront, bluff, canyon and ranch each move on their own cycle. Sand-level frontage clears fastest; canyon inventory sits longest.

Coastal permitting and fire-hardening requirements now shape value as much as square footage does — a buildable, permitted lot commands a premium that did not exist a decade ago.
communities.description_es: Malibú no es un mercado sino doce: playa, acantilado, cañón y rancho, cada uno con su propio ciclo. El frente de playa se vende más rápido; el inventario del cañón tarda más.

communities.name: Santa Monica
communities.tagline_en: Walkable, ocean-cooled, and the tightest supply on the Westside.
communities.tagline_es: Caminable, refrescada por el océano y con la oferta más escasa del Westside.
communities.description_en:
North of Montana holds value through every cycle; Ocean Park and Sunset Park carry the volume. What Santa Monica sells is a fifteen-minute city — buyers give up lot size for the ability to walk to work, school and the water.

Condominium supply is genuinely constrained, and well-run buildings near Palisades Park rarely stay listed a full month.
communities.description_es: Al norte de Montana el valor se mantiene en cada ciclo; Ocean Park y Sunset Park aportan el volumen. Santa Mónica vende una ciudad de quince minutos.

insights.title_en: Where the California luxury market actually stands
insights.title_es: Dónde está realmente el mercado de lujo de California
insights.excerpt_en: Median prices held, but the spread between renovated and unrenovated product widened again. What that means if you are selling this quarter.
insights.excerpt_es: Los precios medianos se mantuvieron, pero la diferencia entre producto renovado y sin renovar volvió a ampliarse.
insights.body_en:
Headline medians are the least useful number in a luxury market, because they average two things that are moving in opposite directions.

Renovated, permitted, move-in product is still clearing close to ask and inside forty days. Unrenovated inventory at the same address band is taking twice as long and closing five to nine percent under list. The median hides both.

For sellers the implication is unglamorous: the pre-market preparation budget is now the single highest-return decision in the transaction. For buyers, the opposite — the discount for taking on a project has not been this wide since 2019.

We publish this report quarterly, drawn from closed transactions rather than list prices.
insights.body_es:
Las medianas de titular son el número menos útil en un mercado de lujo, porque promedian dos cosas que se mueven en direcciones opuestas.

El producto renovado y listo para habitar sigue cerrando cerca del precio de lista y en menos de cuarenta días. El inventario sin renovar tarda el doble.

insights.excerpt_en: The flats, the post-office district, and north of Sunset are three separate markets. A practical guide to which one you are actually buying into.
insights.excerpt_es: Los flats, el distrito de la oficina de correos y el norte de Sunset son tres mercados distintos.
insights.body_en:
People say Beverly Hills as though it were one market. It is at least three, and they price differently enough that confusing them will cost you.

**The flats.** South of Sunset, north of Wilshire. Value tracks lot width and street canopy more than it tracks the house. A fifty-foot lot and a seventy-foot lot on the same block are not the same asset.

**North of Sunset.** Hillside, winding, private. Architecture and view carry the price here, and a difficult driveway can take ten percent off an otherwise strong house.

**Trousdale.** Flat pads, low rooflines, protected views by covenant. It behaves like its own micro-market and often leads the others by a quarter.
insights.body_es: La gente dice Beverly Hills como si fuera un solo mercado. Son al menos tres, y sus precios se comportan de forma lo bastante distinta como para que confundirlos salga caro.

insights.title_en: Six things to settle before you tour a single house
insights.title_es: Seis cosas que resolver antes de ver una sola casa
insights.excerpt_en: Financing, title, insurance and inspection access decide more deals at this price point than the houses themselves do.
insights.excerpt_es: El financiamiento, el título, el seguro y el acceso a inspecciones deciden más operaciones que las casas mismas.
insights.body_en:
At this price point, the buyers who win are not the ones who move fastest on emotion. They are the ones who have already removed every reason a seller might say no.

Settle your financing structure in writing. Confirm insurability early — in fire zones this now takes weeks, not days. Read the preliminary title report before you tour, not after you are in contract. Know your inspection window and who you will actually call. Decide your walk-away number and write it down. And agree, in advance, who in your household has the final vote.

None of this is glamorous. All of it is why one offer gets accepted over a higher one.
insights.body_es: En este rango de precio, los compradores que ganan no son los que se mueven más rápido por emoción, sino los que ya eliminaron cada razón por la que un vendedor podría decir no.

insights.title_en: What actually returns money when preparing a home for market
insights.title_es: Qué devuelve dinero de verdad al preparar una casa para el mercado
insights.excerpt_en: Not the kitchen remodel. A ranked list of pre-market spending by measured return, drawn from our own closings.
insights.excerpt_es: No la remodelación de la cocina. Una lista de gastos previos al mercado, ordenada por retorno medido.
insights.body_en:
Sellers reliably want to spend money in the wrong order. Here is ours, ranked by what we can actually measure across recent closings.

First: paint, light and landscape. Cheap, fast, and it changes the photography, which changes the click-through, which changes the showing count.

Second: whatever an inspector will flag. Roof, drainage, panel, sewer line. You will pay for these either way — paying before the offer costs less than paying during the renegotiation.

Third: staging the four rooms buyers photograph.

A full kitchen remodel three weeks before listing is, in our experience, the least efficient money a seller can spend.
insights.body_es: Los vendedores suelen querer gastar en el orden equivocado. Este es el nuestro, ordenado por lo que podemos medir en cierres recientes.
